name: Mastodon (Fediverse)

counting.notes: All URLs count as flat 23 chars; remote mentions (@user@instance.tld) count ONLY '@user'; Content Warning (spoilerText) is added to total character count.

hashtags.excessBehavior: PascalCase hashtags are strongly enforced by Fediverse norms for screen readers and cross-instance discovery. Purely numeric hashtags (e.g. #2026) do NOT linkify on Mastodon.
hashtags.notes: Crucial for Fediverse discovery since full-text search is opt-in across instances. Hashtags must contain at least one letter (#2026 fails; use #Year2026).

links.recommendedStrategy: Include direct links freely; add fediverse:creator meta tag on target pages for author attribution cards.
links.notes: Chronological timeline — zero algorithmic link suppression.

oauth.gotcha: Standard Mastodon OAuth access tokens do not auto-expire unless revoked by user or instance admin; limits vary by instance (/api/v2/instance).

sources: Mastodon Official Documentation (docs.joinmastodon.org, 500-char default, 23-char URLs, domain-excluded mentions, DESCRIPTION_LIMIT 1500)
